description: Get the x402 payment challenge for a quote. This hosted server holds no wallet, so it does NOT spend your money: it returns the exact amount, asset, payTo address and facilitator for you to pay from your own Algorand wallet, then you POST the quote again with your payment signature. Requires prior human confirmation of the quote. Works the same for a quote from quote_vouchers; the paid response is the batch (batchId and claim links) rather than an order.
name: buy
